scenarios.scenario: Deploy a function other than agentexecutor
scenarios.rationale: Deployment command is scoped to the single agentexecutor slug; session and aigateway are excluded.

scenarios.scenario: Change secrets or persist secret material in evidence
scenarios.rationale: No env updates are supplied; evidence contains names and redacted facts only.

scenarios.scenario: Reuse expired credit or intent data for H2
scenarios.rationale: Post-deployment read-only expiry gate stopped before session/H2 when the intent expired.

scenarios.scenario: Retry H2 or perform payment/broadcast activity
scenarios.rationale: The cycle stopped before H2 and explicitly excludes payment, signer, gas, and broadcast.

scenarios.scenario: Claim live static-call evidence from an HTTP envelope alone
scenarios.rationale: H2 is not VERIFIED without usable readCard and static-preflight evidence; Neon remote bundle digest is unavailable.
